description.value: The Town of Port McNeill Swimming Pool is a publicly accessible outdoor municipal pool operated by the Town of Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island. It offers community swim lessons and recreational swimming in one of the few public pool facilities along the remote northern stretch of the Island Highway corridor. For touring cyclists, it serves as a welcome community hub and refreshment stop in an otherwise sparsely serviced region.
